run_check_valid_test_overlaps: run the script to check for overlaps between training and test multilingual data
run_get_all_test_data: run get_all_test_data to load test sentences across all language directions
run_check_train_all: run check_train_all to find training sentences that appear in test data
run_check_train_sentences: run check_train_sentences to detect overlapping sentences between source and target files
run_load_sentences: run load_sentences to read source and target sentence pairs from a data split
